scope: Actual browser edits, generated data, experimental S3 fixed versions, independent test signature, two disposable WordPress reconstructions

initial paragraph from enrolled public page
typing does not update public content

failed request locks content for exact retry

reload retrieves frozen operation from server

interrupted HTTP save resumes same fixed generation
